## What's new

**About Roach Explorer works.** It used to be a greyed-out placeholder. It now
opens the standard About panel: the app icon, `Version 0.1.2a` read from the
bundle, a one-line description of what the app is, the repository as a clickable
link, and the licence.

`make-app.sh` now stamps the newest git tag into a local build when `VERSION` is
not set, so a build installed in `/Applications` reports the same version the
panel shows. Release runs still pass `VERSION` explicitly, unchanged.

Nothing else changed in this build — no file operations, no navigation, no
shortcuts. The 23 unit tests still pass.

## Installing

Download `RoachExplorer-v0.1.2a.zip`, unzip it, and drag **Roach Explorer** into
Applications. The app is ad-hoc signed, so the first launch may need
right-click → Open. Verify the download with the SHA-256 file next to it:

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c RoachExplorer-v0.1.2a.zip.sha256
```

Requires macOS 14 or later.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HenzeLars/RoachExplorer/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.2a
